selection_rule: Require a successful fit/evaluation, complete LAB coverage of frame centers, and at least one boundary match. Minimize unmatched GT boundaries, then unmatched predicted boundaries, then pooled training MAE, then pooled training RMSE. Errors are rounded to 9 decimal places only for tie handling; exact ties keep the incoming configuration.
